title: Clattering Cuttlefish
statement: Dwelling in a twilight grotto of sunken prisms and swaying copper kelp, this diminutive cephalopod spends its days tirelessly sorting smooth bits of sea-glass into intricate geometric mosaics. Whenever a pleasing new pattern comes together, it clatters two pebbles in quiet triumph and ripples from mantle to tentacle with warm, bioluminescent constellations.
